multi_tenancy.details: Restaurant ID enforced at database, service, and route layers. 196 occurrences of multi-tenancy enforcement validated.

authentication.details: requireAuth middleware applied to all 6 route files. No exceptions found.

error_handling.details: Try-catch blocks on all database operations. Specific error codes handled. Sensitive data masking implemented.

data_migration.details: Migration 020 includes 4-part data transformation with pre/post validation. Rollback instructions provided.
data_migration.validation_checks: Pre and post migration counts match

database_integrity.details: Foreign key constraints with CASCADE delete. Unique constraints on address types. Triggers enforce business rules.

risk_assessment.performance_risk: LOW - Indexes on all foreign keys

load_test_scenarios: Concurrent user access from multiple restaurants

migration_validation_queries.data_migration_check: SELECT COUNT(*) as total, COUNT(restaurant_id) as with_restaurant_id FROM ingredient_vendor_mapping;
migration_validation_queries.address_migration_check: SELECT COUNT(*) as vendors_with_address, COUNT(va.id) as addresses_created FROM vendors v LEFT JOIN vendor_addresses va ON v.id = va.vendor_id WHERE v.address IS NOT NULL;
migration_validation_queries.contact_migration_check: SELECT COUNT(*) as vendors_with_contact, COUNT(vc.id) as contacts_created FROM vendors v LEFT JOIN vendor_contacts vc ON v.id = vc.vendor_id WHERE v.contact_name IS NOT NULL;
migration_validation_queries.multi_tenancy_check: SELECT r.name, COUNT(DISTINCT v.id) as vendor_count FROM restaurants r LEFT JOIN vendors v ON r.id = v.restaurant_id GROUP BY r.id, r.name;

recommendations.description: Execute full data migration validation in staging environment with copy of production database before production deployment
Run multi-tenancy isolation tests with 2+ restaurants to verify no cross-tenant data leakage occurs
Implement error logging and performance monitoring for first 24 hours post-migration. Alert on 401/403/404 spikes

go_no_go_decision.decision_rationale: All deliverables verified. Multi-tenancy enforcement complete at 3 layers. Error handling comprehensive. Data migration strategy documented with rollback capability. No critical issues identified.
go_no_go_decision.contingency: Complete rollback available via migration-020 rollback SQL - estimated 30 minutes to full recovery
